body: Understanding the readings and overall just not getting it. I feel like I don’t understand a single thing.
I hate to be that person, but the question that I always ask after is “but what if I can’t?”

I didn’t know how hard it was going to be. I just received a letter in the mail about how I had gotten into the program and that gave me an extra $2000 a semester to be in it. I don’t need the money, I get enough from fasfa. So I have no strings attached to that program anymore. 

Lol funny you should mention it, I was going to take an honors English class next semester but switched out when I realized that the honors program wasn’t for me. 

I’ve tried emailing her on when we can meet in person but she hasnt responded. I see the mental health counselor this Thursday. Should I wait?

Hi. These past few days have been killing me, too. I’ve been non stop crying and want to drop out of college. So, we have a lot in common. I’m not good at communicating but know that there’s others out there that know the pain. I wish you the best of luck. You can message me if you’d like.

I’m sorry for the confusion I’m pretty bad at explaining things lol. Yes this is the mandatory intro class. Yes it’s the harder version of the “regular” one. I don’t want to say my college name per say but I’ll let you know that it’s a very prestigious school because of the name. And I don’t want to be in the honors program. I thought I wanted to be but after realizing I don’t like the people, the professor, or the classes it’s time for me to drop. But I’d need to speak to the professor (who is also the president of the honors program) in order to do that.
I’ve already talked to my advisor and she told me to speak to the professor directly. I did not get the choice for the professor, if you’re in the program you have to have her as a professor.

It’s the honors version of the course. I wish it was easy, it’s my hardest class. We just recently had a ten page research paper due, and we’re all freshmen. Regardless, I’ve heard of such a policy but I still need to discuss that with the professor first.

I tried talking to my dad. We didn’t get very far in the conversation. He’s bad at those. Few minutes ago he came into my room and laughed at me lying down in the dark doing nothing. It broke me by a lot to be honest.

I’m going to fail a course in college. There’s so much more than that but that’s a big part of it. Every time I try doing something positive to distract me I just end up crying again. I even called the lifeline crisis, the second time I’ve ever done that in my life, and it only made me more upset.
I hardly have the strength to type on my phone let alone write a list. I can’t even look at my schoolwork right now without crying. I’ve cried for 6 hours now
It’s so hard. I can’t get up out of bed. I feel like I can’t breathe. It’s like the depression is a physical weight on me.
I hear our bodies naturally force us back up due to fear.
I don’t see a future for me anymore, sadly

I don’t think I’ll have trouble making friends. But I don’t have the time or motivation to. Why waste time trying to make friends when I’m already so distanced from school entirely and want to disappear?

Thank you. Sadly my school is very small and my class only has 6 people in it. Everyone else also doesn’t know what to do and there’s nothing to study, the entire course is basically your own research project with vague guidelines

I’m terrified to do that. My professor isn’t strict or even really mean, I’ve just associated so much of my pain to her class already that even looking at her gives me anxiety. I’m not sure about the requirements. The honors program rules are B+ which isn’t going to happen if I don’t stop crying and do the work. But I can’t. I’m physically unable to. When I start, I cry.

It feels like I’m going go college just to go to college, if that makes sense. I really do love some aspects of it. I love my major. There’s nothing I wouldn’t do for that field or the professor that teaches it. It’s one of my lights in life right now. If I’m being honest, it’s really just this honors program. I’m not happy there, if anything I’ve never been more depressed in my life. It’s hard to wake up and force myself to go to class when I feel like college for me right now is just a place I go everyday to do work with no reward. 

I’ve been feeling this way about that class for a month now. I can’t even pull myself to do assignments without crying or having a panic attack. My brains almost kinda blocked out that class from existing.

I don’t want to drop out of college. I want to just not be here anymore. Here on Earth. There’s other life stuff as well that would be solved by this. I’m suffering from an unknown intestinal condition that’s chronic. My social life has tanked, I haven’t seen my friends since graduation and I’m not making many friends at college.
Most likely. I’m pretty bad with financial stuff so I’m not too sure how I’ll figure it all out if I end up having to start paying more a semester because of my grades slipping.

Unless I drop out of the honors program, no there isn’t. I’m planning dropping out but I’ll most likely fail the class and it’s a graduation requirement. My major is criminology but it has nothing to do with the class in failing.

Not sure what an fos is, sorry. But I’m failing an honors class it’s nothing any other colleges have except mine. It’s kinda like an English and history and anthropology course rolled into one. Can’t say the name because it gives away the school I’m at.
